outlook.statement: CIRP Processes is completed and a resolution plan has been approved by the Committee of Creditors and has been filed with Hon'ble NCLT for its consideration; the order of Honorable NCLT for approval of Resolution Plan is awaited.

Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company Limited (EARC) who is in the possession of all the Assets of the Company has sold the Assets. CIRP Process is completed and a resolution plan has been approved by the Committee of Creditors and has been filed with Hon'ble NCLT for its consideration; the order of Honorable NCLT for approval of Resolution Plan is awaited.

CIRP Process is completed and a resolution plan has been approved by the Committee of Creditors and has been filed with Hon'ble NCLT on 9th February, 2025 for its consideration; the order of Honorable NCLT for approval of Resolution Plan is awaited.

The Resolution Plan submitted by the Resolution Applicant, Mr. Vivek Kumar Ratakonda, was approved by the Committee of Creditors (CoC) and subsequently filed by the Resolution Professional (RP) before the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench on 9th February, 2025. The approval of the Resolution Plan by the Hon'ble NCLT is awaited.
